what: Rings of product bags, fourteen per ring, with three rings offset by 1/3 each, approach from .85 to 2.05 times every 12s (no curve). Meanwhile each bag rises from 2.5vw below to −7.5vw above with power1.in, and over the first 2s goes from 4px blur and transparent to sharp. Each ring turns once backward in 120s while the bags counter-rotate so they always stay upright, and each bag sways 0 → ±10° → 0 → ∓10° over 15s. Scrolling or hovering the button (boost) adds extra speed, and rings farther away (less approached) speed up more by (1 − progress)². The result is an endless tunnel of bags around the center text.

options.count: Bags per ring (created when there is no pack child), default 14
options.zoom: Seconds for one ring to approach, default 12
options.to: End scale of the ring, default 2.05 (original phone ×1.25)
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Rings (three recommended) — size set by the consumer’s css
options.[data-fx-part=pack]: Bag on the ring (the first child inside shakes and blurs). If absent, the part Makes
options.[data-fx-part=boost]: Button whose extra speed rises to 3 over .925s on hover and falls back over .925s

use: Start Quiz

from.where: index.html .dc-quiz (taste quiz — original QuizWrapper: three rings inner-inner·inner·outer, progress 0/.33/.66, scale .85→2.05 linear 12s, blend-container y 2.5vw→−7.5vw power1.in, blur 4px→0 2s, rings −360° 120s, bag sway u/8=15s ±10°, quickSpeedUp 37 steps × 25ms)

note: The original’s scroll bump converts Lenis deltaY to a time value. The part raises ScrollTrigger velocity (px/s ÷ 60 × .08, max 6) over .3s and lowers it over 1.2s
